messages.author: 24e82fc428bc8a72
messages.subject: corrupt GenomeInformation
parts:
Group

I have a problem with the getGenomeInformation method for
GenomeWideSNP_6.

Here's what happened:
a) I had a nicely created cdf object
b) i had processed data using AvgCnPlm
c) I had been trying to retireve the full annotation info so that I
could do some specialized copy number analysis in some custom regions

I decided to overwrite the getData.GenomeInformation method so that I
could get both the SNP ids and the Unit ids into the dataframe.

somehow in the midst of this process I seem to have 'broken' some
internal object, and now whenever I restart and try to invoke the
default method for :
gi <- getGenomeInformation(cdf,force=T);
result<-gi$getData()

result has only NA entries for chromosome and physicalPosition.

I have gone through the process of resinstalling both the
GenomeWideSNP_6,Full,na24,HB20080214.ufl
GenomeWideSNP_6,Full,na24,HB20080214.ugp
and also
GenomeWideSNP_6,Full,cdf from the Affy source

I DID not recreate the monocell: GenomeWideSNP_6,Full,monocell.CDF

I'm at a loss to understand what I did to corrupt the objects on disk
-- or elsewhere...
i just can't figure what happened...

Comments pls.
Thanks
Chad Shaw

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] corrupt GenomeInformation
parts:
Hi,

it might help in your troubleshooting to clear the
~/.Rcache/aroma.affymetrix/ directory. Your mods to the code might
break the built in memoization. It is unlikely that something was
written to the UGP/UFL files, but you can of course always download
the files again and see if that was the case.

Cheers

/Henrik
